Hourly river flow and water quality data at The Cut, Berkshire

TheCutData.Rd

Hourly river flow and water quality data collected at The Cut, Berkshire, England from May 2010 to February 2012 by the Centre for Ecology & Hydrology (now UKCEH).

This dataset comprises hourly physical and nutrient monitoring data from The Cut at Bray Marina (National Grid reference SU915786). Variables include total phosphorus, total reactive phosphorus, ammonium, conductivity, temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, turbidity and chlorophyll.

Hourly averaged flow data from the Environment Agency gauging station at Binfield (approximately 10 km upstream) are also included. The monitoring programme was funded by EPSRC through the LIMPIDS project.

Usage

TheCutData

Format

A data frame (tibble) with 15,636 rows and 11 variables:

Date / time

Date and time of observation (POSIXct)

Flow at Binfield gauging station (m3/s)

Flow at Binfield gauging station (m3 per second)

Total Reactive Phosphorus (mg/l)

Total reactive phosphorus (mg per litre)

Total Phosphorus (mg/l)

Total phosphorus (mg per litre)

Conductivity (us/cm)

Electrical conductivity

Turbidity (NTU)

Turbidity (NTU)

Total chlorophyll (ug/l)

Total chlorophyll (micrograms per litre)

Dissolved Oxygen (% saturation)

Dissolved oxygen (percent saturation)

pH

Acidity (unitless)

Temperature (C)

Water temperature (degrees C)

NH4 (mg N /l)

Ammonium (mg N per litre)

Source

https://doi.org/10.5285/abe4dd7c-a340-4595-a57f-8c1446ff7656

References

Bowes, M. J., Gozzard, E., Newman, J., Loewenthal, M., Halliday, S., Skeffington, R. A., Jarvie, H. P., Wade, A., & Palmer-Felgate, E. (2015). Hourly physical and nutrient monitoring data for The Cut, Berkshire (2010–2012). NERC Environmental Information Data Centre. doi:10.5285/abe4dd7c-a340-4595-a57f-8c1446ff7656
